rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) annual increase limit
rules.requirement: For rent-stabilized units, rent may go up only once every 12 months, by the allowable percentage set each year. When a tenant moves out voluntarily or is evicted for certain reasons, the rent can be reset to market rate.
rules.requirement_es: En las unidades con renta estabilizada, la renta solo puede subir una vez cada 12 meses, según el porcentaje permitido que se fija cada año. Cuando un inquilino se muda voluntariamente o es desalojado por ciertas razones, la renta puede ajustarse al precio de mercado.
rules.coverage_text: Generally applies to rental properties in the City of Los Angeles first built on or before October 1, 1978 (plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28): apartments, condos and townhomes, duplexes, two or more single-family dwellings on one parcel, long-stay hotel/rooming house units, units attached to commercial buildings, ADUs/JADUs, and mobile homes. Rent amount is not regulated for condo/townhome tenancies that began after December 31, 1995.
rules.quote: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage

rules.title: RSO legal reasons for eviction and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Tenants in rent-stabilized units can only be evicted for listed legal reasons, such as not paying rent or the owner moving in. No-fault evictions require relocation payments, and eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days.
rules.requirement_es: Los inquilinos en unidades con renta estabilizada solo pueden ser desalojados por razones legales indicadas, como no pagar la renta o que el dueño se mude a la unidad. Los desalojos sin culpa requieren pagos de reubicación, y los avisos de desalojo deben presentarse ante LAHD dentro de tres días hábiles.
rules.coverage_text: Generally applies to rental properties in the City of Los Angeles first built on or before October 1, 1978 (plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28): apartments, condos and townhomes, duplexes, two or more single-family dwellings on one parcel, long-stay hotel/rooming house units, units attached to commercial buildings, ADUs/JADUs, and mobile homes. Rent amount is not regulated for condo/townhome tenancies that began after December 31, 1995. Properties not covered by the RSO may be covered by the separate Just Cause Ordinance.
rules.quote: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance
